verdict.rationale: Amplitude has an OpenAPI spec exposed at a public endpoint (amplitude-probe-3) and documented REST/HTTP APIs (amplitude-docs-2, amplitude-docs-12, amplitude-docs-29, amplitude-docs-30), suggesting an API reference exists, but there is no evidence of an interactive explorer with runnable/try-it examples (e.g., a Swagger UI, embedded code sandbox, or 'try it' button). missing for 10: confirmation of an interactive/runnable API reference UI, hands-on evidence of executing sample requests, independent corroboration of the docs experience.
